notes.title: Expert update: Now with 15x15 levels!
notes.content:
Better late than never!
Here is a new update:
- 60 daily levels per day
- Level grids can now be 14x14 and 15x15
- Fix sound not working if the game is installed in a folder with unicode characters

Have fun!

notes.title: Release Notes - Septembre 2021 update
notes.content:
You can now use the right click to place the opposite of the selected item in the grid
 Fix issue with some daily levels not properly saved

notes.title: Release Notes - July 2021 update
notes.content:
Improvements and bug fixes:

 Improvement/Game: You can use the mouse wheel to change the item to place
 Improvement/Menu: The planets positions are kept when going back to the list
 Bug Fix/Game: Hotkeys (1-5) don't allow you to select undiscovered items anymore

Have fun!
